lines.text: The borderlands grow restless. Bandits prey on travelers, and darker things stir in the forgotten places of the realm.
Your small company — three souls bound by duty — has been charged with crossing the frontier before winter seals the mountain passes.

lines.speaker: Roy
lines.text: We'll need to stock up on food and supplies before heading out. Towns have shops and inns, and camps along the road offer a place to rest.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Stay alert on the roads between settlements. Brigands and beasts can ambush us at any time. The longer the route, the more likely we run into trouble.

lines.speaker: Lilina
lines.text: We should check the taverns when we reach a town. Rumors and travelers with useful information tend to gather there.
Click a connected location on the map to travel there. Each hop costs food and may trigger encounters. Choose your path wisely, commander.
